changes.description: Added synthetic loader characterization and explicit execution limitations.
Added hand-repeatable exact-match selections with a synthetic input register.
Added verification checklist and comment export controls.
Corrected maintainer review wording and recorded 58 passed on Linux with Python 3.11.14, pandas 2.3.3 and NumPy 2.3.3.
Recorded 100 % line and branch coverage for platform_loader.py and pipeline_loader.py and replaced stale execution limitations in validation and disposition.
Removed repository-access wording and supplied the path-based coverage command to avoid the dotted-module NumPy reload error.
Recorded the initial commit date and completed revision metadata for the three original change entries.
Numbered the initial HTML revision label to match the structured change record.
Linked the Changes panel to the complete revision history so later revisions remain visible.
